title: Feb 7, 2023 — wind-loaded south aspects
source: Based on a real UAC field observation referenced by the project owner describing wind-loading concentrated on south-facing terrain this day. Exact per-aspect/elevation numbers weren't verifiable against the archived forecast from this environment (avalanche.org unreachable) - treat this scenario's ratings as representative of that wind-loading pattern, not an archival-accuracy copy.
notes: Good scenario for teaching aspect-hopping: the same run can cross from High danger to Moderate danger just by favoring shaded aspects over the wind-loaded south-facing ones.
